ascendants.1: Mesha (Aries): Dynamic, pioneering, courageous, leadership-oriented, independent, quick to action.
ascendants.2: Vrishabha (Taurus): Steadfast, aesthetic, grounded, value-driven, patient, focused on stability and resources.
ascendants.3: Mithuna (Gemini): Inquisitive, articulate, versatile, mentally agile, communicative, fond of learning and networking.
ascendants.4: Karka (Cancer): Emotionally intuitive, nurturing, deeply protective of home and family, empathetic, reflective.
ascendants.5: Simha (Leo): Magnanimous, regal, creative, authoritative, passionate, natural sovereign presence.
ascendants.6: Kanya (Virgo): Analytical, discerning, detail-oriented, service-minded, striving for improvement and precision.
ascendants.7: Tula (Libra): Diplomatic, balance-seeking, refined, cooperative, focused on partnership and justice.
ascendants.8: Vrishchika (Scorpio): Penetrative, intense, transformative, investigative, emotionally resilient, mysterious.
ascendants.9: Dhanu (Sagittarius): Philosophical, optimistic, truth-seeking, expansive, righteous, inclined toward higher knowledge.
ascendants.10: Makara (Capricorn): Disciplined, pragmatic, ambitious, perseverant, structured, oriented toward tangible worldly legacy.
ascendants.11: Kumbha (Aquarius): Visionary, humanitarian, intellectual, unorthodox, connected with community and collective progress.
ascendants.12: Meena (Pisces): Compassionate, contemplative, imaginative, spiritually inclined, empathetic, transcendental.

planet_in_house.Sun_1: Strong vitality, dignified bearing, natural leadership, and high self-esteem; benefits from humility.
planet_in_house.Sun_10: Digbala (directional strength). Supreme authority, rapid professional prominence, public recognition.
planet_in_house.Moon_1: Charming personality, sensitive constitution, emotionally receptive, deeply influenced by mother.
planet_in_house.Moon_4: Digbala (directional strength). Warm home life, emotional contentment, abundant conveyances, deep motherly bond.
planet_in_house.Mars_1: Courageous, assertive, athletic vigor, quick reflexes, high enterprise, potential Kuja Dosha if unmitigated.
planet_in_house.Mars_10: Digbala (directional strength). Outstanding executive drive, commanding authority, triumph over obstacles.
planet_in_house.Mercury_1: Digbala (directional strength). Brilliant intellect, youthful charisma, sharp wit, communicative eloquence.
planet_in_house.Mercury_10: Excellent administrative and analytical faculties, commercial success, literary or media talent.
planet_in_house.Jupiter_1: Digbala (directional strength). Divine blessings, profound moral wisdom, revered status, generous demeanor.
planet_in_house.Jupiter_9: Karako Bhavo Nashaya nuanced: high dharmic devotion, fortunate preceptors, philosophical renown.
planet_in_house.Venus_4: Digbala (directional strength). Luxurious residence, artistic elegance, comfort in conveyances, joyful heart.
planet_in_house.Venus_7: Charming marital partner, appreciation for beauty, social magnetism, mutual romantic appreciation.
planet_in_house.Saturn_7: Digbala (directional strength). Mature, serious, enduring partnerships; delayed but long-lasting stability.
planet_in_house.Saturn_10: Rise to high responsibility through patient labor, sustained grit, eventual public eminence.
planet_in_house.Rahu_10: Unconventional professional rise, foreign interactions, ambition, rapid ascension in modern industries.
planet_in_house.Ketu_12: Moksha Karaka in Moksha house. High spiritual detachment, intuitive contemplation, transcendental liberation.

mahadasha_guidance.Ketu: 7-Year Spiritual Awakening: Time for detachment from trivialities, internal healing, spiritual pilgrimages, and developing intuitive wisdom.
mahadasha_guidance.Venus: 20-Year Flourishing & Affluence: Fosters romance, marital union, creative endeavors, luxury conveyances, artistic refinement, and social harmony.
mahadasha_guidance.Sun: 6-Year Power & Authority: Amplifies career ambition, father's status, public recognition, self-confidence, and connection with governance.
mahadasha_guidance.Moon: 10-Year Emotional Growth: Cultivates inner peace, maternal connections, public outreach, mental sensitivity, and home prosperity.
mahadasha_guidance.Mars: 7-Year Courage & Action: High energy period for physical ventures, property acquisition, overcoming obstacles, and athletic or executive pursuits.
mahadasha_guidance.Rahu: 18-Year Material Expansion: Intense worldly ambition, unconventional breaks, foreign connections, rapid modernization, and worldly trials.
mahadasha_guidance.Jupiter: 16-Year Wisdom & Fortune: Period of auspicious growth, progeny, higher education, spiritual mentorship, ethical standing, and abundance.
mahadasha_guidance.Saturn: 19-Year Discipline & Foundation: Deep karmic maturation, structured perseverance, enduring achievements built through honest, steadfast labor.
mahadasha_guidance.Mercury: 17-Year Intellect & Enterprise: Sharpened commercial acumen, communicative brilliance, academic advancement, networking, and versatility.
